episode_summary: Kim Rittberg emphasizes the critical role of short form videos and AI in enhancing real estate agents' social media presence. She provides actionable insights on leveraging video content to build personal brands and increase client engagement. The episode also highlights AI tools that can streamline content creation and improve productivity.
